component.name: Switch Remote Frame
component.summary: Watch and record your Switch, streamed over USB or the network

description.p: The PC viewer for Switch Remote Frame: watch, play and record the game running on your Nintendo Switch, streamed with sound over a USB-C cable or the network at the game's own resolution and 60 fps.

It needs a Switch running Atmosphère with the Switch Remote Frame sysmodule installed. The viewer decodes on the GPU (VAAPI or NVDEC), records MP4 and takes native-resolution screenshots, with optional FSR 1 and NIS upscaling.
USB needs the udev rule from the project page installed once on the host.

screenshot.caption: A Switch game streamed to a PC over USB

ul.li: The in-stream Settings button can be shown or hidden, with an opacity slider, and fades away two seconds after the last touch or mouse movement on Android and PC.
An About section at the bottom of the PC settings links to the GitHub project.
The support action is now labelled "Support this project".
First release of Switch Remote Frame, a fork of Switch Frame Tap.
Touch control, gamepad and rumble support, and an on-screen virtual gamepad with a layout editor.
Redesigned dark UI across the Switch manager, Tesla overlay, Android/TV app and PC viewer.
